wrong: The firefighters arrived within ten minutes.

ap-1-010.gate_key: active_passive | B1.1 | mcq | Which sentence is correct? | This song was written by my best friend.

key.correct: This song was written by my best friend.
wrong: This song wrote by my best friend.
This song was wrote by my best friend.
My best friend was written this song.

item.q: Which sentence is correct?
item.why: The song does not write: my best friend wrote it. Passive: *was* + 3rd form, *was written*, and *by* + who did it.
item.why_lv: *Dziesma neraksta*: *to* uzrakstīja draugs. Ciešamā kārta: *was* + 3. forma, *was written*, un *by* + darītājs.
item.correct: This song was written by my best friend.
wrong: This song wrote by my best friend.
This song was wrote by my best friend.
My best friend was written this song.
